hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then .venv/bin/python -m py_compile "$f" || echo "SYNTAX ERROR in $f"; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-check Python syntax after every edit

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_EDITED_FILES; do if [[ "$f" == *.ts || "$f" == *.tsx ]]; then cd frontends/sakura && npx tsc --project tsconfig.app.json --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | tail -20; break; fi; done
hooks.description: Auto-check TypeScript types after every edit

hooks.prompt: Before ending, update CURRENT_STATUS.md with: current phase, last completed item, next 3 tasks, any failing tests, current branch, and timestamp.
